hints: Apply the chain rule $\frac{dr}{dt} = \frac{dV/dt}{dV/dr}$ with $\frac{dV}{dt} = 1.5\text{ m}^3\text{/s}$ and $r = 5.5$.
walkthrough:
Differentiate the volume function with respect to radius $r$ using the chain rule:
$$\frac{dV}{dr} = \frac{3}{2} \times 3\left(r - \frac{1}{2}\right)^2 = \frac{9}{2}\left(r - \frac{1}{2}\right)^2$$

Evaluate $\frac{dV}{dr}$ at the radius $r = 5.5\text{ m}$:
$$\left.\frac{dV}{dr}\right|_{r=5.5} = \frac{9}{2}\left(5.5 - \frac{1}{2}\right)^2 = \frac{9}{2}(5^2) = \frac{225}{2} = 112.5\text{ m}^2$$

Use connected rates of change to calculate $\frac{dr}{dt}$:
$$\frac{dr}{dt} = \frac{\frac{dV}{dt}}{\frac{dV}{dr}} = \frac{1.5}{112.5} = \frac{1.5}{225/2} = \frac{3}{225} = \frac{1}{75}\text{ m s}^{-1} \quad (\approx 0.0133\text{ m s}^{-1})$$

ai_rubric.Rates of Change: Differentiates to $\frac{dV}{dr} = \frac{9}{2}(r - 1/2)^2$ (B1). Applies chain rule at $r=5.5$ (M1). Obtains rate $\frac{1}{75}\text{ m/s}$ (A1).

walkthrough:
Determine the value of $\frac{dV}{dr}$ when the radius is expanding at $\frac{dr}{dt} = 0.1\text{ m s}^{-1}$:
$$\frac{dV}{dr} = \frac{\frac{dV}{dt}}{\frac{dr}{dt}} = \frac{1.5}{0.1} = 15$$

Substitute $\left(r - \frac{1}{2}\right) = \sqrt{\frac{10}{3}}$ into the volume formula:
$$V = \frac{3}{2}\left(\sqrt{\frac{10}{3}}\right)^3 - 1 = \frac{3}{2}\left(\frac{10}{3}\sqrt{\frac{10}{3}}\right) - 1 = 5\sqrt{\frac{10}{3}} - 1 = \frac{5\sqrt{30}}{3} - 1 \approx 8.13\text{ m}^3$$

ai_rubric.Rates of Change: Sets $\frac{dV}{dr} = 15$ (B1 FT). Solves for $r - 1/2 = \sqrt{10/3}$ (B1). Evaluates volume to $\frac{5\sqrt{30}}{3} - 1\text{ m}^3$ or $8.13\text{ m}^3$ (B1).
